test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How much approximate amount will be received on a principal of Rs. 40,000 at the rate of 8% per annum to be compounded half yearly at the end of one and half years?
solution:
**Given data:**

Principal = Rs. 40,000, Rate = 8% per annum, Time = 1.5 years, Compounded half-yearly.

**Concept used:**

Compound Interest formula = P(1 + r/n)⁽ⁿt⁾

**Solution:**

Convert annual interest rate to a decimal and time period to half-years:

⇒ r = 8/100 = 0.08

⇒ t = 1.5 × 2 = 3 half-years

Substitute given values into the formula for compound interest:

⇒ A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)

Therefore, substituting the values from step 1 into the equation:

⇒ A = 40000(1 + 0.08/2)⁽² × ¹.⁵⁾

⇒ A = 40000(1 + 0.04)³

⇒ A = 40000 × 1.124864

⇒ A ≈ Rs. 44,995

**Therefore, the approximate amount received at the end of one and half years is Rs. 44,995.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Rate of interest for 6 months = 8/2 = 4%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30fe1aa24e6a264ae2d31cd6d40569f3c99bbed3d9aefa15d698c72a33d4d27c.png] 

In CI, we get interest on interest

Total CI = (1600 × 3) + (64 × 3) + 2.56

⇒ Total CI = 4994.56 ≈ 4995

Amount = 40000 + 4995 = Rs. 44995
